verifications.claim: Kieran Culkin won the Best Supporting Actor Oscar at the 97th Academy Awards in March 2025 for his role in A Real Pain.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Kieran Culkin accepts the Best Supporting Actor Oscar for 'A Real Pain' onstage during the 97th Academy Awards... on March 2, 2025.'; R3: 'Year: 2024 (97th) Academy Awards... Date & Venue: March 2, 2025... Winner: Kieran Culkin... Film Title: A Real Pain'; R6: 'Kieran Culkin won the Oscar for best supporting actor Sunday at the 97th Academy Awards... for... “A Real Pain,”... March 2, 2025'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly state Culkin won Best Supporting Actor at the 97th Oscars on March 2, 2025, for A Real Pain.

verifications.claim: During his 2025 acceptance speech, Kieran Culkin referenced a pact with his wife, Jazz Charton, regarding having more children.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Culkin thanked... his wife, Jazz Charton, whom he had previously bet he would have more children if he won an Oscar.'; R3: Full speech transcript detailing pact: 'she said if I won the award, I would, she would give me the kid... I want four... She said, I will give you four when you win an Oscar. I held my hand out, she shook it'; R5/R6: Quotes speech referencing Emmy pact extended to Oscar for more kids with Jazz.
verifications.reasoning: Speech transcript and reports directly quote Culkin referencing the pact/bet with Jazz Charton for more children during his 2025 Oscar acceptance.
